sources.title: OAICA — install & usage
sources.snippet: OAICA A terminal AI CLI (fork of Ollama's client) backed by our own API. No local GPU or model download required — every request goes to api.sprapp.com, which routes to whichever GPU box is currently serving the model you asked for.
